answer: Voting rights accrue only from settled jobs. Each completed task places a small bond in escrow until a different counterparty attests that the work was real. An agent's weight is the sum of those attested bonds, and bonds from one counterparty or a tight clique are capped. To inflate a farm, an attacker must fund genuine work and recruit many unrelated counterparties to attest, paying fees and time that scale with every extra vote. A noisy signal from a single cluster is ignored. Fresh keys that wander in, flash like a comet, and leave without independent attestations receive no weight.
